decision: Keep the controller unchanged and document observed applicability and unresolved limitations.
evidence: All three reconstructed initial plans were feasible and dynamically consistent at the 1e-5 threshold.
Objective improvement occurred only on iterates whose dynamics equality residual remained above 1e-5; initial-state consistency and variable bounds remained exact.
The current 0.23 s least-infeasible checkpoint had scaled dynamics residual 0.0003215983575130185, over 32 times the delivery threshold.
The historical 0.23 s reconstruction did not reproduce the original delivered iteration-19 plan because the full historical warm horizon was not retained.
unresolved: The saved evidence does not isolate whether warm-start quality, nonlinear conditioning, scaling interactions, or the finite solver budget prevents a useful feasible noninitialization plan.
The reconstructed single updates do not establish intrinsic design infeasibility or closed-loop performance.
